duomo:
You cannot kiss but you shall bring away
Their salt upon your lips. The duomo-bell
Strikes ten, as if it struck ten fathoms down,
Before he went back to the front they went into the Duomo and prayed.
duologues: They lunched slowly and meditatively, with mute intervals between rushes of talk; for, the spell once broken, they had much to say, and yet moments when saying became the mere accompaniment to long duologues of silence.
duodecimo: A light bookcase contained duodecimo volumes of polite literature in calf, completing the furniture.
duos: Brooke’s nieces had resided with him, so that the talking was done in duos and trios more or less inharmonious.
